data.one_liner: Load custom fonts from the network without storing them in local asset folders.
data.what_it_does: Downloads custom fonts from a network URL and caches them locally using Hive and path_provider. Provides utility widgets, text styles, and extensions to render text using the downloaded network fonts.
use_when: You need to load dynamic or custom fonts from a remote server.
You want to avoid bloating your app bundle with static font assets.
avoid_when: You require fonts to be bundled securely offline for first-load guarantees without network connectivity.
You are using font formats other than OpenType (OTF) and TrueType (TTF).
strengths: Automates caching and expiration management for network fonts.
Offers multiple ways to use fonts via widgets, text styles, or extensions.
weaknesses: Limited to OTF and TTF font formats.
Requires active internet connection on the first load to download fonts.
data.setup_notes: No special native permissions or build_runner required; uses path_provider, http, and hive under the hood.
